slides.title: Evaluating Machine Unlearning Against Exact-Retraining Distributions

slides.body:
Successful forgetting should approximate what training would have produced if forgotten samples had never been present.

Surface utility or one privacy attack may not establish that counterfactual.
slides.limitations: The construct requires empirical validation across modalities and methods.
slides.method: Define the counterfactual target before selecting evaluation criteria.
slides.notes: This is the motivation and hypothesis, not an observed disagreement.
slides.reviewer: Could existing evaluation already capture this? The literature and novelty audit remain incomplete.
slides.title: Research problem

slides.body: Approximate unlearning is compared with independently retrained models trained only on D \ F.
slides.limitations: The adequate number of exact replicas remains unknown.
slides.method: Exact replicas use independently controlled seeds and identical retained IDs.
slides.notes: F001 is conceptual and contains no empirical values.
slides.reviewer: Could optimizer mismatch dominate? Training parity must be audited.
slides.statistics: Exact/exact distances form an empirical reference distribution.
slides.title: Counterfactual comparison

slides.body:
2 available datasets

slides.limitations: Only Digits and Fashion-MNIST are available; neither establishes primary-benchmark generalization.

slides.notes: Counts describe artifacts, not strength of evidence. Digits is CI-only and all models are legacy development artifacts.
slides.reviewer: Why count models that fail gates? They remain scientific provenance and are labeled ineligible.
slides.statistics: No uncertainty applies to inventory counts.

slides.title: Counterfactual fidelity is multidimensional

slides.body:
1. RQ1 Do approximate unlearning methods reproduce behavior within the natural distribution of exact retraining?
  2. RQ2 Do conventional forgetting and privacy criteria agree with counterfactual fidelity?
  3. RQ3 Does counterfactual discrepancy accumulate across sequential deletion requests?
  4. RQ4 How do deletion size and composition affect counterfactual fidelity?
  5. RQ5 What counterfactual fidelity is sacrificed for computational savings relative to retraining?
slides.limitations: Hypotheses are neither supported nor rejected.
slides.method: Questions precede confirmatory analysis and map to required evidence.
slides.notes: Every question currently has INCONCLUSIVE status in the machine-readable register.
slides.reviewer: Are these confirmatory? Not until the statistical protocol and matrix are frozen.
slides.statistics: No effect or interval is estimable from eligible evidence.

slides.title: Reproducibility infrastructure

slides.body:
• No confirmatory or publication-eligible run
  • Seed convergence assessed in one pilot condition only
  • No frozen confirmatory statistical plan
  • No CIFAR or tabular corpus
  • No sequential empirical trajectory
  • Incomplete citation recheck and baseline fairness audit
slides.limitations: This list itself may expand after external review.
slides.method: Limitations are drawn from gate and readiness records.
slides.reviewer: Is a paper currently justified? No.
slides.title: Known limitations

slides.body:
Replicate the schema-v2 pilot across original-model seeds, a second deletion fraction, and high-loss deletion.

Then use the expanded pilot variance to freeze confirmatory endpoints, margins, and run counts.
slides.method: Use predeclared deletion manifests and append-only experiment IDs.
slides.notes: This is planned work, clearly separated from completed artifacts.
slides.reviewer: Does k=15 generalize? No; convergence is condition-specific until replicated.
slides.statistics: Carry forward the frozen convergence diagnostic and estimate between-original-seed variance.

slides.title: Verify and inspect

slides.body:
The counterfactual-fidelity question remains scientifically open in this repository.

The defensible outcome of Phase VI is a traceable statement of insufficiency and a concrete path to obtain the missing evidence.
slides.notes: End without implying method performance or novelty.
slides.reviewer: What did this show? It showed readiness boundaries, not unlearning effectiveness.
